question: _____won his 11th National Billiards title on 20 December 2021 in Bhopal.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pankaj Advani.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pankaj Advani is an **Indian billiards** and **former professional snooker player**. 
 
• He has won the** IBSF World Championship **in** billiards and snooker 25 times.**
 
• On **December 20, 2021 in Bhopal**, he won his **11th National Billiards championship.**
 
• He received the** Padma Shri in 2009,** the **Padma Bhushan in 2018**, the **Arjuna Award in 2004,** the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna in 2006**, and other honors. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geet Sethi:**

 
 
• He is a **skilled English billiards **player.
 
• In English billiards, he has won the **professional world championship five times, the amateur world championship three times, **and he holds **two world records.**
 
• **Olympic Gold Quest** was co-founded by Prakash Padukone and Sethi.
 
 
 
• **Dhruv Sitwala:**
 
 
• **English billiards** player Dhruv Sitwala is from India.
 
• In the t**imed version of the IBSF World Billiards Championship** in 2007, Sitwala made it to the final.
 
 
 
• **Ashok Shandilya:**
 
 
• **Billiards player** Ashok Shandilya is from India.
 
• At the Asian Games in Bangkok in December **1998, he won two gold medals** in the pool.
 
• In **1997**, Ashok Shandilya received the renowned **Arjuna Award.**
